€1A bundle, bunch (in general); गुच्छगुल्मं तु विविधम् [[Ms. 1. 48.]] 
__2 A bunch of flowers, a cluster of blossoms, a clump (of trees &c.); अक्ष्णोर्निक्षिपदञ्जनं श्रवणयोस्तापिच्छगुच्छावलिम् [[Gīt. 11]]; [[Ms. 1. 48]]; [[Śi. 6. 50]]; [[Y. 2. 229.]] 
__3 The plumage of a peacock. 
__4 A necklace of pearls (in general). 
__5 A pearl necklace of 32 (or, according to some, of 70) strings; [[Kau. A. 2. 11.]] 
-Comp. 
-अर्धः a pearl necklace of 24 strings. (-र्धः, -र्धम्) half of a cluster. 
-कणिशः a kind of corn. 
-पत्रः the palm tree. 
-फलः 
__1 the vine. 
__2 plantain tree.
